body.x: Watervation (CEO Yoonyoung Joung) announced its participation in CES 2025, which will be held in Las Vegas from January 7 to 10, as part of the K-Startup Pavilion.

Watervation specializes in air purification and pollution reduction solutions that utilize water as a functional filter alternative. By maximizing water resource efficiency and presenting innovative methods for optimizing air quality, the company aims to expand into various industries.

Watervation will introduce its groundbreaking air washing device at CES 2025 to highlight its proprietary technology. This product, recognized as an innovative item by Korea’s Public Procurement Service, achieves air purification and harmful gas reduction using only water without relying on traditional filters.

The core technology driving this innovation is Watervation’s ‘Watering’ method, which enables comprehensive air purification, including humidification and deodorization. Depending on the device specifications, it offers optimal purification performance for daily environments such as offices and homes and large-scale indoor spaces like public facilities and industrial sites.

This technology, poised to revolutionize the air purifier market, has garnered particular attention in advanced industries such as semiconductors and displays. Watervation has also developed modules adaptable to industrial harmful gas purification devices, attracting inquiries about integrating the technology into high-tech sectors.

A company representative stated, “Our products free consumers from the complexity and challenges of filter maintenance, offering a novel air purification solution. With enhanced purification performance, we plan to begin global pre-sales at CES 2025 before the product's official commercialization this year.”

The representative added, “After commercializing small and large air washing devices within this year, we aim to secure overseas partners and immediately enter international markets. Furthermore, by 2026, we plan to supply separate modules for air pollution treatment devices. We will develop and deliver complete air pollution treatment systems the following year, advancing as a global leader.”

AVING News, which has covered CES for 19 consecutive years, continues to bridge the gap for Korean SMEs and startups looking to expand globally. To promote Korean startups worldwide, AVING will host its Broadcasting Zone at the Venetian Expo, featuring the CES Media Day Startup Conference and global media interviews. AVING’s international media partners will cover these programs.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host review conferences with participating companies in Korea, offering a platform for increased visibility and improved corporate image.
